text: It will always happen that he who is not your friend will demand your neutrality, whilst he who is your friend will entreat you to declare yourself with arms. And irresolute princes, to avoid present dangers, generally follow the neutral path, and are generally ruined.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXI, How a prince should conduct himself so as to gain renown
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
